# The docs toolchain: Zensical and everything it installs, at exact versions.
# The whole tree is pinned, not just zensical, so a build on any machine or in
# CI resolves to the same packages and a new release of a dependency cannot
# change the published site unnoticed. Generated by `pip freeze` in a fresh
# Python 3.11 venv (CI's version; Zensical needs >= 3.11) after
# `pip install zensical==<version> "mike @ git+<the mike line below>"`;
# regenerate the same way when bumping.
# Zensical has redirects built in, so mkdocs-redirects is gone with MkDocs.
# mike is Zensical's fork, which publishes the versioned docs
# (docs/publish_docs.py). It is not on PyPI, so it is pinned to a commit; it
# brings pyparsing, verspec and inversion.
click==8.5.1
inversion==1.0.1
Jinja2==3.1.6
Markdown==3.11.3
MarkupSafe==3.0.4
mike @ git+https://github.com/squidfunk/mike.git@2d4ad799442f4592db8ad53b179bfb33db8c69ac
pathspec==1.1.1
Pygments==2.21.0
pymdown-extensions==13.1
pyparsing==3.3.3
PyYAML==6.0.3
tomli==2.5.0
verspec==0.2.1
zensical==0.1.2
zensical-ui==0.0.42
